verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a self-contained iPhone app and ESP32 firmware. There is no documented SDK or API that lets a developer embed device control in their own application. Siri/Shortcuts triggering of saved tasks is a host-platform integration, and the BLE debugging script and trace export are adjacent tools, not an embeddable interface.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed device control in my own application through a documented SDK or API
